name: Orb Producer Suite
summary: AI plugins that generate melodies, chords and basslines in your DAW.
description: Orb Producer Suite offers plugins that generate chord progressions, melodies, basslines and arpeggios as MIDI right inside your DAW. Ideas can then be freely edited.
summary_fr: Plugins IA qui génèrent mélodies, accords et basses dans ton logiciel musical.
description_fr: Orb Producer Suite propose des plugins qui génèrent progressions d'accords, mélodies, basses et arpèges en MIDI, directement dans le logiciel de production. Les idées se modifient ensuite librement.
